name: google-sheets
description: Google Sheets via the official Sheets API v4: spreadsheets, ranges, appends and header-based records

nodes.title: Get Google spreadsheet
nodes.description: Get a spreadsheet's title, URL, locale and its sheets (tabs) with ids and sizes.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create Google spreadsheet
nodes.description: Create a new spreadsheet, optionally with named sheets. With a service account, the file belongs to the service account; share it to see it.

sheet_titles.description: Sheet (tab) titles; default one sheet named Sheet1

locale.description: Locale, e.g. id_ID or en_US (affects number and date parsing)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Add sheet to Google spreadsheet
nodes.description: Add a sheet (tab) to a spreadsheet. Fails with invalid_input if a sheet with that title exists.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

index.description: Position among the tabs (0 = first); default last

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Read Google Sheets range
nodes.description: Read cell values from a range, e.g. sheet "Orders" with range "A1:D". Empty trailing rows and cells are omitted.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

sheet.description: Sheet (tab) title, quoted for you, e.g. My Sheet

range.description: A1 cells such as A1:C10, A:C or 2:5 (with `sheet`), or a full range like 'My Sheet'!A1:C10 or a named range

value_render_option.description: FORMATTED_VALUE = as shown in the UI; UNFORMATTED_VALUE = raw numbers; FORMULA = formulas instead of results

date_time_render_option.description: How dates are returned when value_render_option is not FORMATTED_VALUE

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Read several Google Sheets ranges
nodes.description: Read several ranges in one call. Each range is a full A1 range ('Sheet'!A1:C) or, with `sheet`, cells of that sheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

sheet.description: Sheet the ranges belong to (then ranges are cells only)

value_render_option.description: FORMATTED_VALUE = as shown in the UI; UNFORMATTED_VALUE = raw numbers; FORMULA = formulas instead of results

date_time_render_option.description: How dates are returned when value_render_option is not FORMATTED_VALUE

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Append rows to Google Sheet
nodes.description: Append rows after the last row of the table at `range` (default: the whole sheet). Never retried after an unknown outcome: check with read_range first.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

sheet.description: Sheet (tab) title, quoted for you, e.g. My Sheet

range.description: A1 cells such as A1:C10, A:C or 2:5 (with `sheet`), or a full range like 'My Sheet'!A1:C10 or a named range

rows.description: Rows of cell values, e.g. [["Name", "Qty"], ["Kopi", 2]]; cells are strings, numbers, booleans or null

value_input_option.description: USER_ENTERED parses values like typed in the UI (numbers, dates, =formulas); RAW stores them as-is

insert_data_option.description: INSERT_ROWS inserts new rows; OVERWRITE writes into empty rows below the table

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Update Google Sheets range
nodes.description: Overwrite cells starting at the top-left of `range` with `rows`. Cells outside `rows` are left unchanged.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

sheet.description: Sheet (tab) title, quoted for you, e.g. My Sheet

range.description: A1 cells such as A1:C10, A:C or 2:5 (with `sheet`), or a full range like 'My Sheet'!A1:C10 or a named range

rows.description: Rows of cell values, e.g. [["Name", "Qty"], ["Kopi", 2]]; cells are strings, numbers, booleans or null

value_input_option.description: USER_ENTERED parses values like typed in the UI (numbers, dates, =formulas); RAW stores them as-is

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Clear Google Sheets range
nodes.description: Clear the values (not the formatting) of `range`. To clear a whole sheet, pass `sheet` with `whole_sheet: true` (a missing or empty `range` is refused). Idempotent: safe to retry.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

sheet.description: Sheet (tab) title, quoted for you, e.g. My Sheet

range.description: A1 cells such as A1:C10, A:C or 2:5 (with `sheet`), or a full range like 'My Sheet'!A1:C10 or a named range

whole_sheet.description: Clear every cell of `sheet`; required instead of `range` to clear a whole sheet

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Find rows in Google Sheet
nodes.description: Find rows in a sheet whose first row is the header. Filters compare trimmed text: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, is_empty, not_empty. Returns {row_number, record}.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

sheet.description: Sheet (tab) title, quoted for you, e.g. My Sheet

filters.description: Filters `{column, operator, value}`, e.g. [{"column": "Status", "operator": "equals", "value": "new"}]; none = all rows

match.description: Rows must match all filters, or any

value_render_option.description: FORMATTED_VALUE = as shown in the UI; UNFORMATTED_VALUE = raw numbers; FORMULA = formulas instead of results

date_time_render_option.description: How dates are returned when value_render_option is not FORMATTED_VALUE

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call (an offset into the matches)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Upsert row in Google Sheet
nodes.description: Update the first row whose key column equals the record's key (formatted or unformatted value; only the record's columns change), or append the record as a new row. A text key is written verbatim. Not atomic: two concurrent upserts of a new key can both append, and rows inserted or deleted between the read and the write can shift the target row.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id (the part of the URL between /d/ and /edit) or the full spreadsheet URL

sheet.description: Sheet (tab) title, quoted for you, e.g. My Sheet

key_column.description: Header of the column that identifies a row, e.g. Order ID

record.description: Values by header, e.g. {"Order ID": "A-1", "Status": "paid"}; null clears a cell

value_input_option.description: USER_ENTERED parses values like typed in the UI (numbers, dates, =formulas); RAW stores them as-is

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Google Sheets API request
nodes.description: Call any Google Sheets API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/spreadsheets/{spreadsheet_id}/values/Sheet1!A1:B2". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/spreadsheets/{spreadsheet_id}/values/Sheet1!A1:B2"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
